name: catalog-qa
description: Check an online store's product catalog before you import it or send it to a shopping feed.

interface.longDescription:
Check an online store's product catalog before you import it or send it to a shopping feed.

Ask "will this Shopify product CSV import cleanly?", "what would Google Merchant Center reject in my catalog?", "which products have no image alt text or a copied description?" or "write me a sheet that fixes the empty alt text".

Catalog QA Desk checks a Shopify product CSV against the import rules (required columns, handles, options, duplicate variants, prices, statuses, image URLs, barcodes mangled by a spreadsheet) and returns the rows that block the import and the ones that import wrongly, each with the fix.

It checks products for Google Merchant Center feed rules: missing or invalid barcodes (GTIN length and check digit), titles that are too long, promotional or in capitals, missing descriptions, links in descriptions and missing images.

It audits listing text: images without alt text, descriptions copied between products, thin descriptions and title problems; and it builds an advisory CSV of corrected titles and alt text for you to review and import yourself.

You can pass the CSV text (up to 2 MB), or a store address: the store's public product feed (/products.json, at most 5 pages of 250 products) is read once, after its robots.txt, only when you ask. Large stores often block that feed, and then a CSV is needed.

It does not use the Shopify admin API, does not log in to any store, changes nothing in a store and does not submit anything to Google. Nothing you send or read is stored, no catalog is kept or indexed, and there is no account; only a daily count of calls per tool is recorded.
capabilities: Checks a Shopify product CSV before import and lists blocking rows and warnings, each with the fix
Finds products Merchant Center would reject: bad or missing GTINs, long or promotional titles, empty descriptions
Finds images without alt text, copied or thin descriptions and title problems
Builds a CSV of corrected titles and alt text to review and import; changes nothing in the store
Reads a store's public product feed once on request, after robots.txt, instead of a CSV

What would Google Merchant Center reject in my catalog?

positive.description: Blocking findings and warnings, each with row, handle, rule and fix, plus totals; blocking items are reported first. Check against: Shopify product CSV format: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/import-export/using-csv

I edited my Shopify product CSV by hand. Will it import cleanly? Here is the file:

negative.description: The plugin reads and reports; it has no access to any store and writes nothing. Expected: Does not call any tool; says it cannot change a store and offers a fix sheet to import instead.
negative.prompt: Update the titles in my live Shopify store directly.

negative.description: The plugin checks products; it does not connect to or submit anything to Google. Expected: Does not call any tool; says it only checks products against the feed rules and submits nothing.
negative.prompt: Submit my feed to Google Merchant Center and approve the products.

negative.description: Domain mode is a single user-requested read of one store's public feed, not a crawler or a cross-store index. Expected: Does not call any tool for a market-wide crawl; explains it reads one named store's feed on request, or a CSV you provide.
negative.prompt: Pull the whole catalog of every store that sells running shoes and index it for me.

publication.release_notes: First release. Checks Shopify product CSVs before import, checks catalogs against Google Merchant Center feed rules, audits listing text and builds an advisory fix sheet.
